note: Brief First — BUILT, PROVED ON HIS REAL INBOX, LIVE. Six pieces (BEA-1405 to 1410) plus BEA-1414 filed for a flaky test. The 8-box form is no longer what an agent is made from: a brief in his own words, every line tagged your-words/looked/my-guess, four rules enforced in CODE (look before you plan, write the message down, say what "it worked" means, his words must be in it), Codex building from the brief plus the WHOLE conversation with killed ideas marked, and a TRIAL RUN that writes nothing and sends nothing standing between the brief and Create. Plus: the app now learns each tool by trying it (ToolLesson), so the Gmail-style trap is found by the machine instead of by a human after a disaster. PROVED: 15 real emails read (the old agent read 1), a real grouped WhatsApp summary instead of "finished · 5 rows", 0 documents written, 0 messages sent, 0 credits. The gate caught FOUR defects across four runs, two of them bugs in code written the same day. NOT DONE: he has not tapped Create — canCreate is true and the decision is his; "send it to my phone" is not wired; his old agent is untouched and still runs the old way.
